title: X は Y です — X is Y
explanation: は[k: (as a particle it sounds like わ)] marks the topic.

title: さん — polite name suffix
explanation: Add さん after someone else's name to be polite.

title: ～ですか — polite questions
explanation: Add か to the end of a polite sentence to make a question.

title: ～じゃ ありません — is not
explanation: Replace です with じゃ ありません to say something is not the case.

title: A の B — A's B
explanation: の links two nouns: the first owns or describes the second.

title: だれ_の ... ですか — whose?
explanation: Put だれ_の (whose) before a noun to ask who owns it.

title: これ / それ / あれ は なんですか
pattern: これ / それ / あれ は なんですか
explanation: これ is near the speaker, それ near the listener, あれ far from both.

title: この / その / あの + noun
pattern: この / その / あの + noun
explanation: この, その and あの must come directly before a noun: この ノート (this notebook).

title: N は place に います / あります
pattern: N は place に います / あります
explanation: Use います for people and animals and あります for things.

title: どこですか — where is it?
explanation: Ask where something is with どこですか, and answer with a place word plus です.

title: いま なんじですか — telling the time
pattern: いま なんじですか
explanation: Number + じ is the hour; add はん for half past.

title: Days and when things happen
explanation: Day words like きょう, あした and にちようび work like nouns: X は あした です = X is tomorrow.

title: ～ます / ～ません
explanation: Polite verbs end in ます (do / will do).

title: time に — at a time
explanation: Put に after a clock time to say when something happens.

title: ～ました / ～ませんでした
explanation: Change ます to ました for the polite past, and to ませんでした for the past negative.

title: でした — was
explanation: でした is the past of です: きのう_は にちようび_でした (yesterday was Sunday).

title: place に/へ いきます, vehicle で
pattern: place に/へ いきます, vehicle で
explanation: に or へ[k: (as a particle it sounds like え)] marks a destination.

title: person と — with someone
explanation: と after a person means 'with'.

title: N を ください
explanation: Name the thing, then を ください, to ask for it.

title: いくらですか — prices
explanation: Ask a price with いくらですか.

title: い-adjectives
explanation: い-adjectives end in い.

title: な-adjectives
explanation: な-adjectives (きれい, しずか, げんき) work like nouns: しずかです, しずかじゃ ありません.

title: N が すきです / きらいです
pattern: N が すきです / きらいです
explanation: Use が (not を) with すき and きらい.

title: しゅみ_は ... です — my hobby is ...
explanation: Say your hobby as a noun with しゅみ_は .

title: ～ませんか — won't you ...?
explanation: Turn ます into ませんか for a polite invitation.

title: ～ましょう — let's
explanation: Turn ます into ましょう to say 'let's'.

title: ～て ください — please do
explanation: The て-form plus ください makes a polite request: まって ください (please wait).

title: Making the て-form
explanation: ～きます → ～いて (かいて), ～みます → ～んで (よんで), ～ちます/～います → ～って (まって, いって), ～します → ～して.

title: ～て います — is doing
explanation: て-form + います describes an action in progress: よんで います (is reading).

title: なに_を して いますか
pattern: なに_を して いますか
explanation: して います is the progressive of します.

title: ～ても いいですか — may I?
explanation: て-form + も いいですか asks permission.

title: ～て_は いけません — must not
explanation: て-form + は いけません states a rule: you must not.

title: N が ほしいです / ～たいです
pattern: N が ほしいです / ～たいです
explanation: N が ほしいです = I want N.

title: place へ ... に いきます — go to do
pattern: place へ ... に いきます
explanation: A ます-stem or an activity noun + に before いきます gives the purpose: かいもの_に いきます (go shopping).

title: N が できます / ～こと が できます
pattern: N が できます / ～こと が できます
explanation: N が できます = can do N.

title: N が じょうず / へた です
pattern: N が じょうず / へた です
explanation: Say what someone is good or bad at with が.

title: Dictionary form = casual present
explanation: Friends drop ます: いきます → いく, たべます → たべる, します → する.

title: Casual past and negative
explanation: Casual past ends in た (みた, いった).

title: A は B より ... です
pattern: A は B より ... です
explanation: より means 'than': A は B より はやいです = A is faster than B.

title: どちら_が ... ですか / ～の ほう_が
pattern: どちら_が ... ですか / ～の ほう_が
explanation: Ask which of two with A と B と どちら_が .

title: reason から, result
explanation: Put から after the reason, then say the result: ねつ_が あります_から、 やすみます (I have a fever, so I'll rest).

title: どうしてですか / ～からです
pattern: どうしてですか / ～からです
explanation: Ask why with どうして.

title: ... から ... まで — from ... until ...
explanation: から marks a starting time or place and まで the end: くじ_から さんじ_まで (from 9 until 3).

title: ね and よ in short messages
pattern: ね and よ in short messages
explanation: ね seeks agreement ('isn't it?').

title: Asking for clarification
explanation: Say すみません、よく わかりません when you're lost.

title: Linking steps with the て-form
explanation: The て-form links actions in order: まっすぐ いって、 みぎ_に まがって ください (go straight, then turn right).

title: Polite verb endings
explanation: ます (do), ません (don't), ました (did), ませんでした (didn't), ましょう (let's), ませんか (won't you?), たいです (want to).

title: Linking ideas
explanation: て-form links steps and makes requests.

title: も - also / too
explanation: も replaces は or が to say that the same thing is true of another person or thing.

title: だれ / なに / どこ / いつ - question words
explanation: だれ asks who, なに asks what, どこ asks where and いつ asks when. Keep the word order and add か at the end.

title: Numbers to 100
pattern: いち, に, さん ... じゅう, ひゃく
explanation: Numbers are regular until 10, then combine: じゅういち is 11 and にじゅう is 20. ひゃく is 100.

title: ～つ - general counters
pattern: ひとつ, ふたつ, みっつ ...
explanation: The つ counters work for most objects up to ten and need no noun class.

title: こ / そ / あ / ど - this, that, which
pattern: これ / それ / あれ / どれ
explanation: The こ series is near the speaker, そ near the listener, あ far from both and ど is the question form.

title: が - subject marker
explanation: が marks the subject, especially new information or the answer to a question. It also follows the object of すき, きらい, ほしい and できます.

title: を - object marker
explanation: を marks the direct object of a verb. It sounds like o.

title: で - place of action or means
pattern: place で verb / tool で verb
explanation: で marks where an action happens, or the tool or vehicle used. It is not the same as に, which marks where something exists.

title: と / や - and (nouns)
pattern: A と B / A や B
explanation: と joins nouns completely, while や lists examples and suggests there are more.

title: ～人 / ～枚 / ～台 / ～回 - counters
explanation: Japanese uses different counters for people, flat things, machines and times. The number usually comes before the counter.

title: ～歳 - age
explanation: Ask an age with なんさい. Watch はっさい (8) and じゅっさい (10).

title: N が あります / います - there is
pattern: place に N が あります / います
explanation: あります is for things and います for people and animals. The thing that exists takes が.

title: なにか / なにも - something / nothing
pattern: なにか / なにも + verb
explanation: なにか means something and なにも with a negative verb means nothing.

title: だけ - only
explanation: だけ limits a noun or a quantity to one thing: みず だけ = only water.

title: ～てから - after doing
explanation: The て-form plus から says that the second action happens after the first one finishes.

title: ～た こと が あります - have done
pattern: V-た こと が あります
explanation: This pattern describes an experience you have had at some point in your life, not something you just did.

title: ～ながら - while doing
explanation: ながら attaches to the stem of a verb to say that two actions happen at the same time by the same person.

title: ～とき - when
explanation: とき turns a clause into a time expression: がっこう に いく とき = when I go to school.

title: ～まえ に - before
pattern: V-dictionary + まえ に / N の まえ に
explanation: まえ に says that something happens before an action or in front of a place.

title: ～あと で - after
pattern: V-た + あと で / N の あと で
explanation: あと で says that something happens after an action or event.

title: ～つもり です - intend to
explanation: つもり expresses a plan or intention. The verb before it stays in the dictionary form.

title: ～でしょう - probably
explanation: でしょう adds probability: あした は あめ でしょう = it will probably rain tomorrow.

title: ～かもしれません - maybe
pattern: plain form + かもしれません
explanation: かもしれません is a weaker, more polite guess than でしょう.

title: ～と おもいます - I think
pattern: plain form + と おもいます
explanation: Use と おもいます to give an opinion. The quoted clause takes the plain form.

title: ～んです - explanation
explanation: んです asks for or gives background, reason or context. It is common in conversation.

title: ～そうです - looks like / I hear
pattern: stem + そうです / plain form + そうです
explanation: There are two patterns: a stem before そうです means 'looks like', and a plain form before そうです means 'I hear'.

title: ～ほう が いい です - had better
pattern: V-た / V-ない + ほう が いい です
explanation: This gives advice. Use the past form for a positive suggestion and the negative form for advice against something.

title: ～に なる - become
explanation: になる says that something becomes something else: せんせい に なる = become a teacher.

title: ～て おきます - do in advance
explanation: て おきます says an action is done ahead of time or left in a state for later.

title: ～て しまいました - ended up doing
explanation: て しまいました says an action was completed, often with regret or surprise.

title: から / ので - because
pattern: reason から ... / reason ので ...
explanation: から states a reason directly. ので sounds softer and is common when explaining politely.

title: ～なさい - do (instruction)
explanation: なさい gives a firm but polite instruction, the way a parent or teacher speaks to a child.
